name: com.thesingularityworkshop.fsmapi-advanced
description: A powerful, lightweight Finite State Machine API for Unity with fully adjustable game loop.

samples.description: The complete user guide and API documentation.
A basic example of using the FSM API to toggle a light with user input for the advanced integration package.
Demonstrates defining a movement FSM once and reusing it across multiple independent game objects.
Demonstrates a reusable FSM for constrained scaling along single or multiple axes.
Demonstrates a reusable FSM for constrained linear translation along an axis.
The ultimate demo: showcases multiple concurrent FSMs running simultaneously on the same object for complex motion.
